name: Default
shortDescription: AI research assistant that searches the web, papers and your documents and writes cited reports, bundled with SearXNG and Ollama.

alerts.message: Anyone who opens the site can register an account. Create your own account first, then set LDR_APP_ALLOW_REGISTRATIONS to false and redeploy.

No LLM is preconfigured. Either run ollama pull <model> in the local-deep-research-ollama container (CPU only, so small models are slow) or choose a cloud provider such as OpenAI, Anthropic or OpenRouter under Settings and enter its API key.
